name: Shipping Rates Spreadsheet
author: devStudio8848

sections.description:
Shipping Rates Spreadsheet stores a country (and, in Pro, region and currency) price table on each WooCommerce shipping method instance and applies those prices at checkout.

Use the plugin’s own Shipping Rates Spreadsheet method in a shipping zone, or attach the same matrix to existing methods (Flat Rate, local pickup, carrier plugins, and similar).

Free

  • Spreadsheet-style matrix in the method instance settings
  • One price column: the store currency
  • Country-level destinations
  • Optional built-in Shipping Rates Spreadsheet zone method (can be hidden)
  • Apply the matrix to other zone methods, per instance or in bulk
  • Cost logic: override the method price, add the matrix amount, or take the higher of the two
  • Destinations listed without a price are blocked (the rate is removed)
  • Debug logs under WooCommerce → Status → Logs
  • Cleanup tools for orphaned matrix data
  • Optional removal of matrix data when the plugin is deleted
  • Polish and German translations
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)

Pro

  • Additional currency columns
  • State/region rows (for example US:CA) with country-level fallback
  • Import and export as CSV or XLSX

Matrix data lives in WooCommerce shipping method instance settings. The plugin does not create custom database tables.

Product page: https://devstudio8848.com/shipping-rates-spreadsheet/

Third-party libraries

The matrix editor in the admin uses two bundled MIT-licensed libraries, shipped unmodified:

  • Jspreadsheet CE 5.0.0 — project, source
  • jSuites 6.1.2 — project, source

Versions, licenses, and links to the non-minified sources are also listed in assets/vendor/README.md.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/devstudio8848-shipping-rates-spreadsheet/ or install it from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Activate Shipping Rates Spreadsheet through the Plugins screen.
  3. Open WooCommerce → Settings → Shipping → Shipping Rates Spreadsheet.
  4. Enable the matrix on the built-in method and/or on existing zone methods, then edit those methods to fill the table.
sections.faq:
Does this replace my existing shipping methods?

No. You can keep Flat Rate and other carriers and only apply the matrix to selected instances. You can also hide the plugin’s own method and use assignment only.

What happens if a country is not in the matrix?

For the built-in Shipping Rates Spreadsheet method, the Default cost is used. If that field is empty, the method is hidden. For assigned third-party methods, the rate is removed from checkout.

What happens if the country is in the matrix but the cell is empty?

That destination is blocked for the active currency: the rate is removed.

Can I charge different prices per state or region?

Yes, in Pro. Use location keys such as US:CA. If there is no region row, the country row is used.

Can I set prices in several currencies?

The free version uses the WooCommerce store currency only. Pro adds extra columns.

Where is the data stored?

In each method’s instance option (woocommerce_{method_id}_{instance_id}_settings), under the ds8848_srs_matrix key. Nothing is written to custom tables.

How do I remove plugin data?

Enable Remove data on uninstall in the Shipping Rates Spreadsheet settings, then delete the plugin. You can also run the on-screen orphaned-data cleanup without uninstalling.
